title: Product Owner
description:
ECARX is a global automotive technology provider partnering with OEMs to accelerate the future of software-defined vehicles. As OEMs develop new vehicle platforms from the ground up, ECARX is developing a full-stack solutions to enhance the user experience, while reducing complexity and cost.
To date ECARX products have been integrated into more than 8.7 million cars worldwide, and we continue to shape the interaction between people and vehicles by rapidly advancing the technology at the heart of smart mobility. Founded in 2017, and listed on the Nasdaq in 2022, we have more than 1,800 team members across Europe, Asia and the Americas working towards one ambition: to redefine the driving experience 
We are now looking for a Product Owner to join our team in Gothenburg. 
About the role
The purpose of the role is to serve as a Product Owner. This involves defining goals and creating a vision for the assigned area from a high-level perspective. The Product Owner is responsible for generating a backlog of items and prioritizing them in accordance with the overall strategy and business objectives established by the Product Manager.
To ensure that the product's vision, strategy, and priorities are aligned, the Product Owner should invest a significant amount of time in understanding the product and the value it delivers. Additionally, the Product Owner serves as the primary communicator and liaison between stakeholders and teams.
Main responsibilities
Prioritizing and managing the product backlog to ensure smooth development
Translating strategies devised by product managers into actionable tasks for development
Gaining insights into the market and customer requirements to enhance product quality
Acting as a liaison between product and development teams to ensure seamless communication
Being available to answer development team's queries and concerns
Providing an explanation of why the product is best and how it aligns with the overall product strategy
Attending Feature & Planning HUB and Trinity meetings as an active member
Managing stakeholder expectations effectively



Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience working as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar role within software development.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum, and experience working in Agile development teams.
Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs, including writing and refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
Ability to translate business objectives and product strategies into clear and actionable development requirements.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and expectations.
Experience gathering, analyzing, and prioritizing customer, user, and market requirements.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to act as an effective bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Demonstrated ability to define product goals, communicate product vision, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
Experience working closely with software developers, UX/UI designers, and other product team members throughout the development lifecycle.
Ability to make prioritization decisions and provide clear guidance to development teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously.
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English.

title: System Engineer to ALIARO
description:

ALIARO was founded in 2014 with the ambition to deliver innovative and dependable testing solutions to clients across a wide range of industries worldwide. Since then, the company has grown into a leading provider of modular and reusable test solutions designed to adapt to changing technical and business needs.
The team consists of experienced engineers with deep expertise in testing and measurement. Continuous skill development is a natural part of the work, and ALIARO maintains close partnerships with leading hardware and software providers such as National Instruments (NI). title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer to Markem-Imaje
employer: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
description:
Om jobbet
Markem-Imaje is a trusted world manufacturer of product identification and traceability solutions, offering a full range of reliable and innovative inkjet, thermal transfer, laser, print and label application systems. Markem-Imaje delivers fully integrated solutions that enable product quality and safety, regulatory and retailer compliance, better product recalls and improved manufacturing processes.
Markem-Imaje Sweden in Gothenburg is something as unusual as a small innovation and development hub with a startup mindset within an established global company.
Our mission is to lead the development of new innovative products and solutions, from concept to production with the freedom to use the work methods we find most efficient. We love what we do, and we have help from the global organization we are a part of.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced, skilled, and self-driven Principal Embedded Software Engineer, with a system mindset and an interest in exciting technology. You, just like we do, appreciate working with the complete development cycle, from idea to finished product, via proof of concept and implementation, using effective methods and tools.
In this role, you will:

Develop control software in C++ and Go, as well as associated software architecture, in cooperation with developers from both the local office and other offices within the global organization.


Bring a system level view, understanding how the software interacts with the hardware, how different customers use the products, and using that knowledge in architectural and prioritization work.


Be part of an experienced and passionate team that develops not only software but also electronics and mechanics, with the possibility to share ideas, experience, and knowledge.


Influence design choices within all development disciplines.

What You Will Do
You will develop controller software in C++ and Golang, as well as associated tests, for a controller running embedded Linux that cooperates with other components within the printer, such as MCUs and FPGA. You will interface with other engineering disciplines, engineering teams, stakeholders, and customers to understand the application space and business requirements and use that understanding to influence technology selection and decisions, both within the company and together with major customers.
Beyond day-to-day development, you will:

Lead and facilitate high level software estimation to support business planning activities.


Mentor and teach other software engineers in improving their skills.


Lead design reviews and drive improvements in design and code quality produced by internal and external engineers.


Drive continuous improvement in source control and continuous integration by staying up to date with the latest industry practices and tools.


Test and fault find code written by yourself and by others.


Throughout, you'll work closely with the team to achieve shared goals, and influence and inspire others through personal credibility.
What You Need To Have
Bachelor's or Master's degree with significant professional experience developing software, and a demonstrable record of delivering high-quality embedded software for end user products from requirements analysis to delivery.


Expert in writing portable, cross-platform, modern C++ code, with solid experience in Go/Golang and expert knowledge of real time operating system (RTOS) concepts.


Expert architecture and design skills, functional decomposition, architectural viewpoints, UML/SysML, and design patterns, together with advanced implementation skills such as multithreaded and distributed systems programming and on target debugging.


Demonstrable experience in a technical leadership role within a software team and for external engineering resources, including code reviews, design reviews, and mentoring.


Advanced knowledge of electronics, including microcontrollers, memory and peripherals, and experience reading schematics and using oscilloscopes/logic analyzers.


Swedish, French, Italian, or Polish language skills would be beneficial but are not a requirement.
If you believe you match our values and have the experience we're looking for, then apply as we review applications on a rolling basis! We can't wait to hear from you!

title: Software Engineer (C/C++)
description:
We are seeking an Embedded Software Engineer with Interest in Advanced Testing and Troubleshooting, focused on ensuring stability and ongoing evolution of critical security components for the automotive middle-layer platform.
Our team is dedicated to developing and enhancing the Secure Gateway, a solution ensuring tha only trusted data is allowed to interact with the vehicle. As we embark on building the next-generation mobility platform, we’re setting the foundation for the most secure vehicles on the road.
You’ll be responsible for writing requirement-based tests, maintaining code quality to AUTOSAR standards, ensuring stability of the Component within Continuous Integration systems and handling bug mitigation, if such will be found.

Software development (C/C++, Python)
Embedded systems
Networking stacks and protocols (e.g. TCP/UDP, Ethernet)
Automotive industry

Cybersecurity

Participate in problem solving taskforces together with other developers and testers
Develop and run automated tests

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Computer Vision
description:
About Repli5: Repli5 is a small Swedish startup based in Gothenburg that specializes in bringing Generative AI to computer vision applications. Our technology, called RealSim, leverages gen AI to bridge the gap between synthetic data and reality. This is particularly useful for creating accurate, realistic training data for computer vision models, essential in developing solutions for industrial robotics, autonomous drones, and select automotive applications. Our technology is also capable of enhancing real-world images by introducing extensive weather and lighting variations, which significantly increases the robustness of downstream computer vision models. We are now packaging this tech into a platform service built for computer vision engineers.
The Opportunity: Shaping the Future of AI Perception We're looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer with a deep background in computer vision and generative AI. You’ll be part of a team developing workflows that generate realistic, diverse, and highly controllable synthetic image data using state-of-the-art tools like Stable Diffusion, LoRA, and ControlNet. These workflows will be adapted and applied to our new platform and your work will thus directly impact Repli5’s business and the performance and robustness of real-world AI systems—from self-driving cars to industrial automation.
What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Develop and fine-tune generative AI pipelines (e.g., Stable Diffusion, ControlNet, LoRA) for synthetic image generation.


Design and implement machine learning workflows to generate structured, photorealistic datasets.


Collaborate with 3D artists and simulation engineers to align ML models with physical environments and sensor setups.


Work closely with customers in automotive, robotics, and aerospace to deliver tailored datasets.


Optimize generation systems for scalability, quality, and speed using tools like ComfyUI or custom pipelines.


Who You Are (Qualifications)

The Essentials: MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or related field with 3+ years of hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow). Extensive experience with state-of-the-art image generation models (GAN, Diffusion, Transformers)


Exploring Mindset: Experience exploring workflows with generative AI models (especially diffusion-based) and a strong passion for reading and applying new research papers.


Toolset Curiosity (Big Plus!): Familiarity with tools like LoRA, ControlNet, ComfyUI, or custom workflows around Stable Diffusion.


Domain Knowledge (Big Plus!): Strong understanding of synthetic data generation and its role in training perception systems.


Practitioner: A track record of deploying ML systems in domains like industrial automation, defense, or automotive.


The Startup Gene: You excel in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where you can take initiative and work independently.


A Team Player: A problem-solving intellect with a team player spirit and a positive can-do attitude.


What We Offer

A competitive compensation package.


Flexibility and work-life balance.


Challenging tasks that are at the forefront of technology.


The autonomy to make major technical decisions and influence the product direction.


An international, caring culture where it is natural to both ask for and offer help.


Flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home some days a week.


Fun at work.

Application Review
